name: literature-deep-reading-assistant
title_zh: 七段式拆一篇论文，笔记带引用出处可回查
tagline_zh: 从定位到批判再到迁移，七步走完一篇论文。每步产出都标原文页码。
tagline_en: Seven stages from positioning to critique to transfer. Every claim links back to the exact PDF page, so your.
desc_en: Deep-read one academic paper from a local PDF or Zotero item and create traceable Markdown notes for Obsidian through the seven stages of positioning, deconstruction, evidence extraction, reconstruction, critique, research transfer, and synthesis. Use automatically when the user asks to 精读、深读、系统阅读或批判性阅读 a single paper; analyze its research question, concepts, theory, method, evidence, mechanism, f
why_zh: 不是泛泛总结，而是把论文拆成研究问题、概念、理论、方法、证据、机制六层，每层都强制你回原文找依据。
why_en: It doesn't summarize—it dissects a paper into six layers (question, concepts, theory, method, evidence, mechanism), forcing each.
limit_zh: 只精读单篇论文，不处理多篇对比或综述；只吃本地 PDF 或 Zotero 条目，不接网页链接。
limit_en: Single-paper only—no multi-paper synthesis. Local PDF or Zotero items only, no URLs. Output is Markdown; no automatic graph or backlinks.
title_en: Seven-stage paper deconstructor with traceable notes
